'''Dust stalkers''' were a predatory [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Madlands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].

==Description==
Similar in appearance to the [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]], dust stalkers were native to the [[Madlands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. A six-legged [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] with razor-sharp teeth and two large grabbing arms protruding from its back, the dust stalker was extremely vicious and violent. A dust stalker was released from captivity by [[Orl Miscord/Legends|Orl Miscord]] in a plot to kill the owner of a caravan, [[Sala Vindako]].<ref name="NoP" />
